name: Hello
author: brodgar
description: Example addon + standing regression harness — runs in the Lua sandbox (self-checks it at OnLoad; READ-ONLY (declares no permissions), so it is default-enabled and needs no consent — the gated hafen.act write tier now lives in the separate, opt-in 'walker' addon, which declares 'permissions': ['actions'] and is therefore disabled by default, its enabling gated by a per-addon consent dialog with no global switch — D-027/D-028) over the event bus, timers, saved variables (hafen.store), custom UI (hafen.ui — a draggable window, a HUD overlay, and world-space gob overlays, all drawn via the GOut wrapper), client-only world ghosts (hafen.ghost — V1: new{res,x,y[,a]} places a virtual prop (a Gob with no server id) in the 3D world and returns a handle with :move/:pos/:res/:clickable/:destroy, list([filter]) lists this addon's live ghosts; SAFE-tier and NOT gated (D-029) since nothing reaches the server; V2 adds opt-in clickability — clickable=true (or :clickable(bool)) gives a ghost a pick surface and a click on it is detected client-side and CONSUMED before any server click (so you never walk/interact — still SAFE-tier, D-032), firing the per-ghost onClick and the owner-scoped GhostClicked{ghost,button,x,y} event; a non-clickable ghost is click-through; V3 adds look & orientation — new{...a=,alpha=,tint=,sdt=} plus the handle verbs :rotate(a)/:setRes(res[,sdt])/:alpha(0..1)/:tint{r,g,b[,a]}/:show()/:hide() (alpha<1 is the translucent 'ghost' look, tint is a colour overlay); at OnEnterWorld the harness spawns a non-clickable log cabin a few tiles away ROTATED and TRANSLUCENT (click-through), reads list()/pos(), moves it, then live-swaps its resource + rotates it, hides & re-shows it, and auto-destroys it after 8s, and ':hello ghost' toggles a CLICKABLE translucent cabin at your position — click it: it logs onClick + GhostClicked, live-rotates + re-fades itself (V3), and you do not move), custom images (hafen.render -- R1: hafen.render.image(path) loads a PNG from THIS addon's own folder into a client-only, bridge-owned TexI handle (paths are addon-relative and sandboxed: absolute / '..' are rejected, D-017) with :size() -> {w,h} and :dispose(); draw it inside any draw callback via the g wrapper: g:image(img,x,y[,w,h]) (native or scaled) and g:aimage(img,x,y,ax,ay) (anchored); SAFE-tier and NOT gated (D-034) since it never reaches the server, and it is disposed AUTOMATICALLY on reload/disable so there is no GL leak; hello loads icon.png at OnLoad and draws it in the 2a window (native 32x32 + scaled 16x16) and the 2b HUD overlay (anchored beside the readout)), custom world sprites (hafen.render -- R2a: hafen.render.sprite{image,x,y[,a,scale,alpha,tint]} stands a custom PNG UPRIGHT in the 3D world as a fixed textured quad -- the non-.res sibling of a ghost, on the SAME client-only virtual-entity core (a Gob with no server id, SAFE-tier and NOT gated, D-034), so it is a transform handle like a ghost: :move/:rotate/:scale/:alpha/:tint/:clickable/:show/:hide/:pos/:image/:destroy, gizmo-compatible, torn down automatically on reload/disable; ':hello sprite' stands the icon.png at your feet (~3 tiles tall) then, 2s later, moves + rotates + scales it to show the live transform, and ':hello sprite' again removes it; R2b adds the CAMERA-FACING BILLBOARD form -- hafen.render.sprite{...,billboard=true} draws the PNG as a screen-space blit at the projected world point so it always faces the camera and stays a constant screen size (position + gizmo-move apply, world-rotate/scale do not), and ':hello billboard' stands one facing you; a FIXED sprite can also be made clickable=true (a billboard has no world mesh, so it is never picked), firing the per-sprite onClick and the owner-scoped SpriteClicked{sprite,button,x,y} event just like a ghost; it can also be ANCHORED to a gob and FOLLOW it every frame -- hafen.render.sprite{follow=<gob id|'player'|'me'>, offset={x=,y=,z=}} (z=up) plus the handle verbs :follow(gob[,{x=,y=,z=}])/:offset{x=,y=,z=} (a plain :move detaches), the world-space analog of a gob overlay: ':hello follow' floats icon.png above your head and it follows you as you walk), custom 3D models (hafen.render -- R3a/R3b: hafen.render.model(path) loads a glTF 2.0 STATIC model (.glb preferred, or .gltf + buffers) from THIS addon's folder into a cached, bridge-owned mesh handle (:bounds()->{min,max,size} world units, :info()->{prims,textured,lit,textures,verts,tris}, :dispose()); the pure-Java parser bakes the glTF (+Y up) into H&H model space (Z up; 1 metre = 1 tile) as POSITION + indices with multiple primitives/materials, and R3b decodes TEXCOORD_0 + the baseColorTexture (embedded/data-URI/external PNG-JPG -> shared TexIs owned by the mesh) x baseColorFactor with alpha modes OPAQUE/MASK/BLEND + doubleSided cull, and R3c adds LIGHTING (baked per-vertex normals + a Phong material state, so the model shades with the world lights instead of drawing fullbright; :info().lit counts the lit primitives). hafen.render.object{model,x,y[,a,scale,alpha,tint,clickable,onClick,follow]} then stands the model in the 3D world -- the mesh sibling of a sprite/ghost, on the SAME client-only virtual-entity core (a Gob with no server id, SAFE-tier and NOT gated, D-034), so it is a transform handle like a sprite: :move/:rotate/:scale/:alpha/:tint/:clickable/:show/:hide/:pos/:mesh/:destroy, gizmo-compatible, torn down automatically on reload/disable; hello loads tank.glb (a real textured, multi-material model) at OnLoad (logging its prim/texture counts) and ':hello object' stands it TEXTURED at your feet -- scaled from :bounds() to ~2 tiles tall -- then, 2s later, moves + rotates + grows it to show the live transform on a mesh, and ':hello object' again removes it), widget-creation interception (hafen.ui.onWidgetCreate — observes every server window the client builds and logs its {id,type,place,caption,parentType} descriptor), widget models (hafen.ui.adopt — adopts the main inventory as a hidden model: Ctrl+B hides/shows its grid while it stays live, with items() reads and onItemAdded/onItemRemoved/onDestroy events; un-hides on reload/disable), map markers (hafen.markers — reads the on-disk map DB with list/nearest, and Ctrl+Shift+M drops/removes a persistent 'Hello marker' at your position; MarkersChanged fires on changes), radar/minimap icons (hafen.radar — reads the gob-icon categories with categories() -> {name,res,show,notify}, and can setVisible/setNotify per filter; read-only in this addon since the setters persist to your real icon settings), kin/buddy roster (hafen.kin — reads the Kin window with list([filter]) -> {id,name,group,color,online} and find(nameOrId); KinChanged fires when a kin is added/removed or flips online/offline, and hello names who just came online; read-only since kin add/remove/rename is the gated Phase-4 tier), movement speed (hafen.speed — reads the crawl/walk/run/sprint selector with get() -> current 0..3, max() -> highest selectable, name([n]) -> display name; read-only since changing speed is the gated Phase-4 tier), crafting (hafen.craft — reads the open recipe/craft window with current() -> {recipe, inputs, outputs, qmod, tools} (inputs/outputs are {res,name,num,opt} specs; qmod/tools are {res,name} arrays), or nil when none is open; read at login (usually 'none') and via ':hello craft' which dumps the recipe you currently have open; read-only since craft.make is the gated Phase-4 tier, and there is no CraftChanged event — read on demand), quest log (hafen.quests — reads the character sheet's Quest Log with list([filter]) -> {id,name,res,status,mtime} for both the Current and Completed tabs, and selected() -> the open quest plus its conds={{desc,status,text}} objectives; QuestAdded fires when a new active quest appears and QuestDone when one is completed/failed, and ':hello quest' dumps the selected quest's objectives; read-only since there is no quest action tier), wounds (hafen.wounds — reads the character sheet's Health & Wounds tab with list([filter]) -> {id,name,res,severity,parentid,level} (wounds form a tree via parentid; severity is the magnitude the client shows beside a wound) and has(needle); WoundChanged fires when a wound is added/healed or its severity changes, and ':hello wound' dumps the full wound tree; read-only since wounds heal by playing/tending), combat schools (hafen.fight — reads the character sheet's Martial Arts & Combat Schools tab, the OUT-OF-COMBAT maneuver-deck builder: maneuvers([filter]) -> {res,name,avail,used} for every known maneuver/attack, deck() -> the current school's configured card layout {slot,key,res,name,used} for the filled hotkey slots, and summary() -> {maxact,used,nact,nsave,usesave} (the action-point budget + active saved-school slot); read at login and via ':hello fight' which dumps the deck by hotkey plus your known maneuvers; read-only since editing/switching schools is the gated Phase-4 tier, and there is no FightChanged event — read on demand), global hotkeys (hafen.key.bind — Ctrl+H toggles the window + an unbound 'ping', both shown under a 'Hello' section in Options > Keybindings), slash commands (hafen.slash.register — a WoW-style ':hello' console command with sub-commands 'toggle'/'ping'/'echo'; args come in as a 1-based table; reload-safe via a single engine-lifetime dispatcher, so :reload swaps the handler with no duplicate/leaked command — coverage-gaps C1), JSON (hafen.json — self-checks encode/parse at OnLoad: hafen.json.encode(value) -> compact JSON (strict — a function/userdata/cycle/non-finite number is a pcall-able error, so output is always valid JSON) and hafen.json.parse(str) -> Lua value (objects -> string-keyed tables, arrays -> 1-based; JSON null -> nil = an ABSENT key / array hole; integral numbers -> Lua ints; malformed input or over the size/depth caps -> a pcall-able error), the harness round-trips a mixed table and verifies the null->nil caveat + integer cleanliness; ungated pure CPU, D-036), input hooks (hafen.hook.input — a MapView mousedown pre-hook that cancels map clicks while 'map-lock' is on), action hooks (hafen.hook.action — a MapView 'click' pre-hook that intercepts a move and re-sends it while 'move-intercept' is on), message hooks (hafen.hook.message — an IMeter 'set' pre-hook that swallows meter updates so the vitals bars freeze while 'vitals-freeze' is on), and the read API (hafen.gob.*, hafen.world.*, hafen.map.*, hafen.player.* incl. vitals, hafen.time.*, hafen.sound.*, hafen.items.*, hafen.char.* incl. food/skills/credos/experiences, hafen.party.*, hafen.buffs.*, hafen.study.*, hafen.actionbar.*, hafen.radar.*, hafen.kin.*, hafen.speed.*, hafen.craft.*, hafen.quests.*, hafen.wounds.*, hafen.fight.*) plus the widget-tree events (VitalsChanged, BuffAdded/Removed/Changed, FepChanged, StudyChanged, ActionbarChanged, EquipChanged), the map event MarkersChanged, the kin event KinChanged, the quest events QuestAdded/QuestDone, the wound event WoundChanged, and the world-entity click events GhostClicked (ghosts) and SpriteClicked (fixed sprites).
